Therabody taps NetSuite to simplify global operations, create AI powered workflows, and reduce tech costs

Therabody, a specialist in wellness technology, is using Oracle NetSuite. It says that, with NetSuite’s AI powered cloud enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, it has scaled its business by unifying its global operations, automating order management, and increasing productivity across its team.
